name: FreeInference (Harvard SEAS)
description: Harvard SEAS's MadSys Lab serving frontier open models free to every account.
overview: FreeInference is run by the MadSys Lab at Harvard SEAS as an experimental research service: every registered account gets free access to frontier open models behind both OpenAI-shaped (`/v1`) and Anthropic-shaped (`/anthropic`) endpoints, with a documented Claude Code setup. Only models marked Free accept a Free key. Capacity-dependent limits are not published, and prompts and responses may be logged and sanitised excerpts published for research.
free_access: Free keys reach models marked Free
notes: Research service: allowances vary with capacity and prompts may be published in sanitised form.
